seller_loyalist.description: Established account whose 24 bids all go to a single seller's listings

sniper_burst.description: Five bids inside the final 9 seconds on each of 6 auctions

combo_new_account_single_seller.description: Day-old account, bidding 3x in ~10s bursts, exclusively on one seller's new listings
